values.note: 11 electric camper sites (1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 are 30 ft; 2, 4, 6 and 8 are 40 ft; 10 and 11 are 70 ft) and 5 tent sites.

sites.source: https://www.saintpetermn.gov/490/Camping ('11 Camper/Electric Sites', '5 Tent Sites', 'Sites 1, 3,5, 7, 9 are 30ft', 'Sites 2, 4, 6, 8 are 40ft', 'Sites 10 and 11 are 70ft'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.saintpetermn.gov/490/Camping ('Our campsites provide 30 amp power hookups only and NO WATER available, just drinking fountain and bathrooms.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online (Rec1, card payment) or through the Recreation and Leisure Services office. Stays over seven days in a row need prior approval. Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.; cancel two business days ahead for a refund less a $3 fee.

booking.source: https://www.saintpetermn.gov/490/Camping ('Reservations can be made online or at the Recreation and Leisure Services Office'; 'Reservations made online require a credit card payment'; 'Check out is at 11 a.m. and check in is at Noon'; cancellation 'Must be requested 2 business days prior to the reservation', 'Full refund minus a $3 administration fee') + rules PDF ('A person/group may not camp for more than seven days in succession without prior approval.'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: https://www.saintpetermn.gov/490/Camping ('Campground will be open May 1 - November 1'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Electric sites $30 a night; tent sites $20.

fees.source: https://www.saintpetermn.gov/490/Camping ('Camp sites with electric - $30 per night', 'Tent site with no electric - $20 per night'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Saint Peter campground in the 120-acre Riverside Park on a bend of the Minnesota River, beside the Mill Pond; boat ramp, canoe landing, fishing pond, playground and trails. No swimming in the pond or the river. One camping unit per site. --Claude
summary: City page and rules read: 11 electric sites (30 A only, no water; 30/40/70 ft) + 5 tent sites, $30 / $20, showers, flush toilets, dump; Rec1 or office booking; 7-day limit without approval; May 1 - Nov 1. Riverview kept. Note cleaned (the 'same-day at the Police Dept' line is no longer on the page).
flags: WATERFRONT riverview kept: on Esri z19 imagery the campground is an open lawn with a gravel loop on a peninsula in a Minnesota River bend (~44.3220,-93.9522); every side toward the river is a band of trees 30-50 m deep before the sandy bank, so no pad is on open ground within ~50 m of the water. Individual pads could not be picked out; the stored riverview (filtered view through the tree fringe) stands. The fishing pond is the ~2-acre Mill Pond (a pond, no pond value).

HOOKUPS: water was not stored; the page says 'NO WATER available' at sites, written as water false. Only 30 A: 'If you are bringing a 50-amp RV or trailer, please ensure you have the appropriate adapter'.
NAME: the city calls it 'Riverside Park - Mill Pond Municipal Campground' (stored 'Riverside Park Municipal Campground'); consider the city's name.
PHONE 507-934-0667 (Recreation and Leisure Services) confirmed; after-hours voicemail 507-934-0673. WEBSITE lines current. Pin is on the campground lawn.
